name: dbt Cloud
description: dbt Cloud is dbt Labs' managed platform for building, testing, scheduling, and orchestrating SQL-based data transformations inside a data warehouse, adding a browser IDE, job orchestration, a semantic layer, and governance features for analytics engineering teams.
best_for: Analytics engineering teams that want a managed platform for building, testing, scheduling, and documenting SQL data transformation models, with a real self-serve paid tier rather than starting at contact-sales pricing.
features: Studio IDE, a browser-based environment for building and testing SQL data transformation models
Job scheduling and orchestration for automating end-to-end transformation pipelines
Built-in testing for monitoring data pipeline and model health
dbt Semantic Layer for defining consistent, reusable metrics
dbt Catalog and lineage for data governance and discovery
Role-based access control (RBAC) and SSO for managing users and permissions
Git integration (GitHub, GitLab, or a generic git repo URL) for version-controlled development
dbt Mesh for managing multi-project architectures across teams (Enterprise tiers)
pros: Free Developer plan includes a real, usable seat (up to 3,000 successful model builds/month), not just a stripped-down demo
The paid Starter plan has a published self-serve price ($100/developer seat/month) rather than starting at a sales conversation
New signups get a 14-day free trial of the paid Starter plan's features
cons: The Starter plan requires five developer seats to start, so the effective minimum spend is $500/month rather than a true single-seat paid tier
Enterprise and Enterprise+ both require contacting sales, with no published numeric pricing for either

pricing.starting_price: Free Developer plan (1 seat); paid Starter plan is $100/developer seat/month, billed monthly, with a five-seat minimum

tiers.name: Developer
tiers.notes: One developer seat, 1 project, up to 3,000 successful model builds per month, browser IDE, MFA, and job scheduling. Includes a 14-day free trial of the Starter plan.

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Billed monthly by credit card; requires five developer seats to start. Includes 1 project, up to 15,000 successful model builds/month, 5,000 queried metrics/month, dbt Wizard, basic Catalog, basic Semantic Layer, and API access.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Custom developer seat count, up to 100,000 model builds/month, 20,000 queried metrics/month, 30 projects, advanced Catalog/Semantic Layer, dbt Copilot, Canvas, Insights, and Mesh.

tiers.name: Enterprise+
tiers.notes: Custom pricing; contact sales. Same usage limits as Enterprise but unlimited projects, plus PrivateLink, IP restrictions, rollback, and hybrid projects.

alternatives.name: Fivetran
alternatives.description: A managed ELT platform that, alongside data movement, can also orchestrate dbt Core transformation model runs directly (including a free monthly allotment), rather than requiring a separate dedicated transformation product.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want their data-movement platform to also trigger and run transformation models, rather than operating a dedicated transformation-and-orchestration product like dbt Cloud.
strengths: Combines data movement and dbt Core transformation runs in one platform
Free tier includes monthly transformation model runs
One vendor covers both EL and T

faq.question: Is dbt Cloud free?
faq.answer: dbt Cloud has a free Developer plan with one seat, 1 project, and up to 3,000 successful model builds per month. Paid plans start with Starter at $100 per developer seat/month (five-seat minimum), with Enterprise and Enterprise+ available at custom, contact-sales pricing.

faq.question: How is dbt Cloud priced above the free plan?
faq.answer: The Starter plan bills $100 per developer seat/month, monthly, by credit card, with a minimum of five seats. Enterprise and Enterprise+ both use custom pricing that requires contacting dbt Labs' sales team.

faq.question: What's the difference between dbt Cloud's Enterprise and Enterprise+ plans?
faq.answer: Both offer the same usage limits (up to 100,000 model builds/month, 20,000 queried metrics/month) and advanced features like dbt Copilot, Canvas, and Mesh, but Enterprise caps projects at 30 while Enterprise+ allows unlimited projects and adds PrivateLink, IP restrictions, rollback, and hybrid projects.
